title: PPIA-16 Cross-Screen Component Interaction Contracts
purpose: Define deterministic behavior for the eight Foundation cross-screen components, especially candidate identity, provenance, findings, evidence receipts, stop conditions and nonactivation disclosures.

components.name: Authority Badge

behavior.ready: render exact class text plus accessible explanation
behavior.stale: retain original class and add stale relationship; never demote/promote silently
behavior.conflict: show each conflicting source with its own badge

components.accessibility: text is mandatory; color/icon may supplement only
components.mobile: badge may wrap but never truncate authority class into ambiguous initials

components.name: Candidate Identity Chip

behavior.current: full SHA available on focus/expand and copy action
behavior.stale: explicitly says stale and identifies selected current candidate when known

components.accessibility: screen-reader name includes repository, relationship and SHA/ref; copied value is exact, not display-shortened
components.mobile: short SHA may display visually but full exact value remains one action away and in accessible name

components.name: Raw Status Pill

behavior.rule: raw token is never replaced by a friendlier normalized word; optional explanation follows
behavior.completion: only completed_verified may use complete wording
behavior.mixed: multiple tools remain separate pills rather than collapsed green/yellow/red

components.accessibility: raw token precedes explanation in accessible name
components.mobile: pill wraps with source label; color is never sole carrier

components.name: Source Stack

behavior.ready: sort by authority precedence, then recency only within same authority class
behavior.stale: mark lagging source without hiding it
behavior.conflict: expand conflict summary and prevent silent derived merge

components.accessibility: ordered list semantics communicate precedence; controlling source is announced
components.mobile: stack is vertical with governing source expanded by default and derived sources collapsible

components.name: Finding Row

behavior.current: blocking effect derives from current active gate/input binding
behavior.historical: historical label prevents automatic current-blocker implication
behavior.protected: summary redacts protected payload while retaining enough locator/rule data to diagnose safely
behavior.resolved: resolution evidence is linked; original finding remains inspectable

components.accessibility: row has deterministic reading order source, raw state, summary, scope, blocker effect, next action
components.mobile: row expands to card; blocker effect and next action remain above optional details

components.name: Evidence Receipt Card

behavior.stale: candidate mismatch is explicit and receipt cannot satisfy current gate
behavior.digest: producer-defined digest is copied verbatim; console never substitutes invented digest
behavior.mutation: authoritative_mutation_performed is always visible, including false

components.accessibility: receipt summary announces raw result, candidate relationship, mutation flag and limitations before optional details
components.mobile: candidate, result, mutation flag and limitation stay in first card region

components.name: Stop Condition Panel

behavior.clear: shows no currently triggered stop condition but does not imply completion
behavior.triggered: blocks incompatible execution actions and names exact condition/source
behavior.unknown: treat as unresolved authority for governed mutation; observation/navigation remain available

components.accessibility: triggered condition is announced before any disabled execution control explanation
components.mobile: panel remains pinned near action review and cannot be collapsed when a condition is triggered

components.name: Nonactivation Strip

behavior.rule: false means not authorized by PPIA-16, not globally impossible; any true value must cite an external governing source and exact scope
behavior.missing_source: cannot render true without source; show unresolved/false-for-this-surface instead

components.accessibility: plain-language summary available without reading eight icons
components.mobile: compact summary may collapse details only when all remain false; any externally authorized true value expands automatically with source

shared_focus_rules: Refreshing a component never moves focus unless the focused control disappears; then focus moves to the nearest stable heading and a concise change announcement is made.
Opening source/evidence returns focus to the invoking component when navigating back.
Blocking state changes announce the changed blocker and action availability, not the entire page.
Copy actions expose exact underlying SHA/ref/path/digest even when visual text is shortened.
shared_mobile_rules: Authority, candidate relationship, raw result, blocker effect and next action are never hidden behind horizontal scrolling.
Tables may become cards, but field labels and semantic grouping remain equivalent.
No safety-critical component depends on hover, dense tooltip-only content or unlabeled iconography.
